capabilities: Adds an Office-style ribbon of tabs, groups and buttons
Runs any Obsidian or plugin command from a button
Customises buttons, groups and tabs by right-click and drag and drop
Hides Markdown syntax while typing and shows a selection Quick Bar
Adds note tags, subpages, notebooks and section tabs
disambiguation: Not a OneNote import or sync tool; the main feature is a customisable command ribbon, with OneNote-like extras alongside it.
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux), Obsidian 1.10.6 or newer. By default it also sets a purple accent, Segoe UI and Calibri; this can be turned off. No network calls or telemetry. OneNote ink, audio recording and OneNote import are not included.
intentEvidence: most of that power sits behind a command palette and hotkeys. If you come from Office, that is friction
motivation: The author wanted to remove the friction Office users feel when Obsidian's features are reachable only through the command palette and hotkeys.
problem: Obsidian's power sits behind the command palette and hotkeys, which is friction for people used to Office-style menus and toolbars.

relations.evidence: Its AI group runs AI ChatBridge's sync commands with one click
the same format as the Highlightr plugin
Subpages in Notebook Navigator are indented and marked

summary: Office-style ribbon of tabs, groups and command buttons for Obsidian, plus OneNote-like note tags, subpages, notebooks and syntax-free editing.
